title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $190.99 on Ecovacs Deebot T90
excerpt: Score an Ecovacs robot vacuum while stock is still available.
content_html:
SAVE $190.99: As of July 31, the Ecovacs Deebot T90 is on sale for $509 at Amazon. That's a 27% discount on the list price.

Credit: Ecovacs

$509 at Amazon
$699.99 Save $190.99

It's official, the FCC has announced it will ban new foreign-made mobile robots from entering the U.S. market. This includes Ecovacs robot vacuums, among other popular brands. The good news for shoppers is that the ban won't affect previously approved devices, so existing robot vacuum stock will remain available to purchase. But if you've been hoping to get an Ecovacs model, act fast before stock drops.

It's not all bad news: if you've been eyeing the Ecovacs Deebot T90, it's currently on sale for $509 at Amazon.

This model isn't just a robot vacuum; it also has a built-in mop. It has a 30,000Pa BLAST suction to remove dirt, while the OZMO Roller 3.0 mop system uses a 10.6-inch self-washing roller with pressurized scrubbing to tackle spills and dried stains. The roller is cleaned with fresh water during use to help reduce streaks and residue, and TruEdge 3.0 extends the mop beyond the robot’s body so it can reach along awkward edges and corners.

Plus, when it's done, the OMNI docking station will automatically wash the mop roller with adjustable hot water up to 167°F, dry it with hot air, and clean the dirty water system to reduce maintenance.

该模型不仅仅是一个扫地机器人；它还是一个扫地机器人。它还有一个内置拖把。 它具有 30,000Pa BLAST 吸力，可清除污垢，而 OZMO Roller 3.0 拖把系统采用 10.6 英寸自洗滚筒，具有加压擦洗功能，可解决溢出物和干污渍。 滚筒在使用过程中用清水清洁，有助于减少条纹和残留物，TruEdge 3.0 将拖把延伸到机器人身体之外，这样它就可以沿着不方便的边缘和角落进行清洁。
